tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The summary, key points and chapters of a YouTube video or podcast episode, with a link to its full transcript, if blumify.io already has it. Give the video or episode URL.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
